# linear-equation-isolation

Use inverse operations to isolate one variable in a linear equation.

## 适用条件

1. The equation is linear in one variable.

## 解题流程

1. Simplify both sides of the equation.
2. Apply inverse operations to isolate the variable.

## 校验

1. Substitute the result into the original equation.

## 不适用情形

1. The equation contains a nonlinear variable term.

关键词：linear equation、inverse operations
